verdicts.reason: A is scattered. The headline breaks as 'Chase the / Light', leaving 'Light' alone on its own line. The body copy is squeezed into a narrow five-line column with single words on several lines, and it floats unaligned between the can and the CTA. The SOLSTICE logo is tiny and sits low inside a decorative circle, as does the NEW FLAVOR badge, so the reading order is jumbled. B has a clear left-to-right banner structure: badge, headline, body and CTA in one column, with the can on the right. Its flaws still need fixing: 'hour.' is orphaned on its own line, the NEW FLAVOR pill and the CTA are oversized and crowd the top and bottom edges, the can is jammed near the bottom edge, and the logo at top right is very small.
